summary: 60-year-old male Nederland-area resident found unconscious in the trees along the "Hot Dog Alley" run at Eldora Mountain Resort after an apparent solo tree collision earlier in the day; ski patrol first aid/CPR unsuccessful, pronounced dead in the first aid room ~11 a.m.; BCSO and coroner investigated, no suspicious circumstances (BCSO 21-5910)
location: "Hot Dog Alley" run, Eldora Mountain Resort
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Boulder County Coroner's Office; Eldora ski patrol
notes: Decedent skiing alone; identity withheld pending next-of-kin notification.
